blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur – All cities and municipalities in nearby Ilocos Norte have been declared drug-cleared, completing the province’s drug-clearing process at the local government level. The latest declarations covered Laoag City and the municipalities of Badoc, Bangui, Pasuquin, Piddig, San Nicolas, and Sarrat during the sixth deliberation of the Regional Oversight Committee on Barangay Drug Clearing (ROCBDC) on Tuesday, Nov. 17.
